narrative:
Technology and premises investment is about £6.6M a year: lending platform and broker portal digitisation £2.6M, the savings platform and online portal £1.4M, the data and AI platform (Snowflake, DCM Projects, Cortex) £1.2M, identity, cyber and resilience £0.9M and office fit-outs £0.5M.

Depreciation and amortisation is about £4.6M a year and rising as the digitisation programme goes live.
